test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Compulsory
solution: The correct answer is: **Voluntary**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Compulsory **means required or mandatory. (आवश्यक या अनिवार्य) • **Example**: *Wearing a seatbelt is compulsory for all passengers.* • Marked option **Voluntary **means optional or done by choice. (वैकल्पिक या पसंद से किया गया) • **Example**: *Joining the after-school club is voluntary; students can choose whether to participate.* • Therefore, the antonym of compulsory is voluntary. Thus, the correct answer is **option 3**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Obligatory**: Required, usually due to a rule or law. (आवश्यक, आमतौर पर किसी नियम या कानून के कारण) • **Mandatory**: Required by authority or rules. (प्राधिकारी या नियमों द्वारा आवश्यक) • **Subsidiary**: Secondary or supplemental; serving to assist or support. (माध्यमिक या पूरक; सहायता प्रदान करना) 14d:T61f, The correct answer is: "**Disagreeing with each other's ideas.**"
